actions.name: Conducted fraudulent emergency data requests using compromised government email addresses
actions.description: Cyber-criminals are likely gaining access to compromised US and foreign government email addresses and using them to conduct fraudulent emergency data requests to US based companies, exposing the personal information of customers to further use for criminal purposes.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: Posted sale of high quality .gov emails for espionage/social engineering/data extortion/Dada requests
actions.description: In August 2024, a known cyber-criminal on an online forum posted their sale of “High Quality .gov emails for espionage/social engineering/data extortion/Dada requests, etc”, which included US credentials.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: Guided buyers through emergency data requests and sold stolen subpoena documents
actions.description: The poster indicated they could guide a buyer through emergency data requests and sell real stolen subpoena documents to pose as a law officer.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: Owned government emails from over 25 countries enabling access to private client information
actions.description: In March 2024, a known cyber-criminal on an online forum indicated they “owned” government emails from over 25 countries, and that through a successful subpoena, the requestor could gain access to usernames, emails, phone numbers, and other private client information.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: Submitted fraudulent emergency data request to PayPal using a fake MLAT
actions.description: In March 2024, a known cyber-criminal posted photos on an online forum of a fraudulent emergency data request submitted to Paypal. The request included a case number and legal code for verification but was ultimately denied by PayPal.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: Sent fake emergency data requests with urgent statements to coerce immediate information disclosure
actions.description: In December 2023, cyber-criminals would send a fake emergency data request, along with a statement to provide the requested information immediately, indicating an individual would suffer greatly or die unless the requested information was provided by the company.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: Used .gov emails to carry out emergency data requests and impersonate law enforcement
actions.description: In October 2023, a known cyber-criminal stated on an online forum that .gov emails could be used to carry out emergency data requests on users, and allow a user to “become” a law enforcement officer or government entity.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: Used data obtained from emergency data requests to carry out phishing or malware attacks against government sector
actions.description: The data obtained could be used to carry out phishing or malware attacks against the government sector and become an initial access vector.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: Taught individuals how to create and submit their own emergency data requests for $100
actions.description: In August 2023, a cyber-criminal stated they were teaching individuals how to create and submit their own emergency data requests to get information on any social media account for 100USD.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.
